mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 93 degrees and an elevated air quality index of 58. We are currently under a waxing gibbous moon, and the overnight low will reach 68 degrees with rain expected to move in.

The City Clerk's office is excited to announce that entries for the I Voted sticker contest are closed, and the community can view and vote on designs from K-12 students between July 28 and August 7. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes before the winter season to ensure they meet USPS specifications to avoid damage during plow operations.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and then on July 28, head over to Hop Haus or Lake Louie for trivia night.
Regarding local safety, a noteworthy incident occurred on July 13 when officers responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a rock, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.

For dessert tonight, Culver's is serving up OREO Cookie Overload. They are open until 10 PM, which is four hours from now, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat before they close for the night.
